tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0027 1. Lemma 1.19\group so3-isotropy

There exists a time $T_0>0$ depending only on the initial data $(A_0,B_0,C_0)$ such that the solution $g_\varepsilon (t)$ of (1.5) exists for all $0\le t<T_0$ and all $0<\varepsilon \le 1$.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0027 \sketch The quantities $(AE)$ and $E/(BC)$ satisfy differential inequalities that yield a uniform lower bound for $BC$ on a time interval depending only on the initial data, and this in turn bounds the evolution of $A$ from below. Hence the solution persists on a common interval independent of $\varepsilon $.

□
